helpers.name: Vlasov.wassersteinGronwallCoupling_gronwall_le
helpers.one_line_math: For a continuous function h on [0, T] with h(0) ≤ δ and right-derivative liminf bounded by C * h(s) everywhere on [0, T), Gronwall's inequality gives h(t) ≤ δ * exp(C * t) for all t ∈ [0, T]. This is a clean wrapper around Mathlib's le_gronwallBound_of_liminf_deriv_right_le with ε = 0.

helpers.name: Vlasov.wassersteinGronwallCoupling_real_bound
helpers.one_line_math: Given the sub-axioms MathlibTODO_wassersteinGronwallCoupling_W1ContOn and MathlibTODO_wassersteinGronwallCoupling_derivBound, apply the Gronwall wrapper to conclude (wasserstein1 (f t) (g t)).toReal ≤ (wasserstein1 (f 0) (g 0)).toReal * Real.exp(C * t) for t ≥ 0.

helpers.name: Vlasov.wassersteinGronwallCoupling_ennreal_mul_comm
helpers.one_line_math: For reals δ ≥ 0, the ENNReal equality ENNReal.ofReal (δ * exp(C * t)) = ENNReal.ofReal(exp(C * t)) * ENNReal.ofReal δ follows from ENNReal.ofReal_mul and mul_comm.
helpers.proof_sketch:
rw [mul_comm δ (Real.exp (C * t))]
rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.exp_pos (C * t)).le]
mul_comm

helpers.name: Vlasov.wassersteinGronwallCoupling_ofReal_le
helpers.one_line_math: Lift the real-valued bound (wasserstein1 (f t) (g t)).toReal ≤ (wasserstein1 (f 0) (g 0)).toReal * exp(C*t) to the ENNReal inequality wasserstein1 (f t) (g t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(exp(C*t)) * wasserstein1 (f 0) (g 0), using ENNReal.ofReal_toReal_le to pass from ofReal(toReal(x)) back to x.

axioms.name: MathlibTODO_wassersteinGronwallCoupling_W1ContOn
axioms.statement_summary: For two Vlasov solutions f and g with L-Lipschitz gradW and finite first moments, the map t ↦ (wasserstein1 (f t) (g t)).toReal is ContinuousOn every [0, T]. Requires Wasserstein distance continuity along measure-valued ODE flows.
axioms.one_line_math: The Wasserstein-1 distance (as a real number via toReal) between two Vlasov solution curves is continuous in time; this follows from narrow continuity of Vlasov solutions (itself not in Mathlib's stable API).

axioms.name: MathlibTODO_wassersteinGronwallCoupling_derivBound
axioms.statement_summary: For two Vlasov solutions f and g with L-Lipschitz gradW and C ≥ L > 0, the right-derivative liminf of t ↦ (wasserstein1 (f t) (g t)).toReal is bounded by C * (wasserstein1 (f t) (g t)).toReal at every t ≥ 0. Requires the characteristic flow coupling argument and W₁ triangle inequality under pushforward.
axioms.one_line_math: The characteristic flow coupling (pairing particles of f and g via the same initial label) produces a joint transport plan whose cost grows at rate ≤ C * W₁(f_t, g_t), yielding the differential inequality d/dt W₁(f_t,g_t) ≤ C * W₁(f_t,g_t). This is the core Dobrushin estimate and requires measure-valued ODE Picard theory + W₁ triangle inequality under pushforward, neither of which is in Mathlib.
